name: drupal/generator_engine
description: Generate dummy content entities (nodes, users, taxonomy terms) for development and QA, from the UI, Drush or HTTP APIs.

suggest.drush/drush: Required by the generator_engine:generate command and the procedure commands.
suggest.npm-asset/codemirror: Enables syntax highlighting on the JSON and YAML generation forms. Requires asset-packagist and an installer-paths entry mapping it to libraries/codemirror; without it the forms fall back to a plain textarea.
